name: Inverted Face Pull
instructions: Set a barbell low in a rack or use rings at chest height.
Hang underneath with straight body, heels on the floor.
Pull your face to the bar, driving the elbows high and wide.
Lower with control. A bodyweight face pull for the rear delts.
cues: Pull the elbows to the ribs
longevityNotes: Pull twice as much as you push and your posture will age well. Rowing and pull-up strength are among the best predictors of a capable, pain-free upper body later in life.
overview: Inverted Face Pull is an intermediate pulling exercise for the rear delts, performed with just your bodyweight. Pulling balances all the pressing we do in life and keeps the upper back and posture strong.
